messages:
lucy: Planning note 12pm PT demo next Thu. Need reg page, Zoom + RTMP backup, clear clip owners, and a fast replay send. Goal: three 4590s socials + one 6m highlight for SDRs.
omar: Ill build the form. Single CTA to register; add checkbox "send clips" to segment. Hidden fields: utm_campaign=demo_q2, demo_bucket.
hana: Zoom config: cloud record speaker + gallery, separate audio tracks, auto-transcript on. RTMP -> backup ingest endpoint. Waiting room off, passcode on.
ben: Ill own clip edits. Priority: 1) benchmark stat (0:10-0:55), 2) cost/latency before-after (0:56-1:40), 3) UX quick tour (1:41-2:30). Omar, please drop timestamps as comments in recording.
kate: Post-event cadence: T+10m replay to registrants (link + 45s clip CTA). T+20h attendees get 6m highlight. T+4d non-attendees get benchmark PDF + invite to on-demand office hours.
ingest-bot: RTMP backup set: rtmp://ingest.redwood/backup_demo_3130 (placeholder). Cloud recording id: rec_3130_link (placeholder).
omar: Drive folders created: /Marketing/Events/Demo_3130/raw, /clip_cuts, /masters. Form will set hubspot props: attendees, registrants_no_show, send_clips.
lucy: Rehearsal Mon 15m prior. Assign chat monitor and one person to note clip timestamps live. Owners: reg=form=omar, zoom=config=hana, messaging=cate, edits=ben, event lead=lucy. React with :white_check_mark:.
hana: Confirmed and rehearsal added.
ben: Confirmed, will prep edit template.
lucy: Thanks team. Drop any blockers here.
